onset.Description: Event time in this file (sequences back-to-back)

trial_type.Description: Letswave event code as stored, except that a leading patient code (letters of the patient's name) before '_greyscale...' is replaced by 'seq'. Codes are not documented in the release (most frequent: 's1' and '65535'; the long codes contain the stimulation sequence name)

latency_in_sequence.Description: Letswave event latency on the sequence time axis, which starts at 2 s (header xstart)
